publicReleaseNotes: Oncall can now deliberately run with outbound mail off by selecting MAIL_PROVIDER=none. No sender or mail key is needed in that mode; conflicting sending inputs are refused. The owner enters a hosted installation with guarded rer signin using the recorded deployment and deploying credentials; email sign-in links remain unavailable. Enabled mail providers still need real sender settings and credentials. Settings → Team now explains how administrators share installation-local sign-in steps with members, and local addresses are labelled as usable only on that computer. Rota swaps exclude shifts with existing cover and explain how to remove that cover before requesting a swap. Bulk-action previews use alert titles, and move-in erasure receipts and import history use readable labels. Install, restore, hosting and signed Events API guidance now follows the supported commands without requiring a global Node installation for the HMAC example. Native export path validation promptly refuses malformed paths without excessive regular-expression backtracking. The dependency refresh updates re2js to 2.8.7 and seroval to 1.8.1. This patch uses rer 0.2.118 and adds no migrations; all 68 applied migration files stay unchanged. Back up before upgrading and keep the existing pager authoritative: paging stays OFF.
agentUpdateInstructions: From 0.5.15, back up local data with rer export --output exports/before-0.5.16.rer. For a hosted installation, export its D1 database with npx wrangler d1 export DATABASE --remote --output exports/DATABASE.sql using the original deploying Cloudflare credentials; DATABASE is recorded in .rer/deploy/ENVIRONMENT.json. Keep the backup private and verify it before upgrading. Stop the local app with Ctrl-C, run git pull --ff-only, then rer dev; from a detached release tag use git fetch --tags && git checkout v0.5.16 instead of git pull --ff-only once the release is published. For a hosted installation, update the original deploying checkout and run rer deploy --environment ENVIRONMENT with the same credentials. This patch adds no migrations; keep all 68 applied migration files unchanged and do not reset a populated installation. The checkout pins rer exactly to 0.2.118. Outbound mail may be deliberately disabled with MAIL_PROVIDER=none supplied to rer deploy in the environment or an --env-file; omit sender, mail-key and relay inputs in that mode. An absent provider does not select mail off. Keep existing enabled-provider settings unless deliberately changing the mail choice. With mail off, the owner uses rer signin --environment ENVIRONMENT from the recorded deploying checkout with the same Cloudflare credentials; email sign-in links are unavailable. Enabled mail still requires its real sender and provider credentials. Team members use their administrator-created installation-local workspace name and password at /signin/local; Oncall sends no invitations. Restore only into an empty destination with rer import --input exports/before-0.5.16.rer --yes, then check the owner, services, schedules, incidents, shared policies and agent settings. An archive older than a recorded erasure is refused; do not bypass that refusal. Confirm the archived administrator and their name when mapping the new installation owner. Restored agents stay paused and pending or in-flight approvals expire; the installation owner must resume agents and old proposals need fresh authorized calls. Recorded on-call notification runs and settings restore inactive and never prove delivery. Review imported service/person matches and supported shared rota/policy targets before adoption; unsupported targets remain paused. Paging stays OFF; keep the existing pager active. To update from 0.3.0, back up first: locally with `rer export --output exports/NAME.rer`; for a hosted installation export its D1 database with `npx wrangler d1 export DATABASE --remote --output exports/DATABASE.sql` (the name is in `.rer/deploy/ENVIRONMENT.json`) using the deploying Cloudflare credentials. Locally, stop `rer dev` with Ctrl-C, run `git pull --ff-only`, then `rer dev`. Hosted, from the checkout that deployed, run `git pull --ff-only` and `rer deploy --environment ENVIRONMENT` with the same credentials; the owner, schedules and incidents are kept. The update applies ten additive migrations (0117-0126); keep all 32 applied migrations unchanged and do not reset to upgrade. Restore a backup only into an empty destination (`rer import --input exports/NAME.rer --yes` locally, a fresh empty installation when hosted). Paging stays OFF; keep your existing pager active. From 0.2.0, stop with `rer dev --stop` and `rer preview --stop`, then run `git pull --ff-only` and `rer dev`. The update applies four additive migrations (0113–0116); keep all 22 applied migrations unchanged and do not reset to upgrade. Data, the owner and password accounts are kept. People who sign in with a workspace password sign in once more, because the held session cookie is now named `oncall_session_<port>`. Captured local sign-in mail is removed with the development outbox; open the app with the `RER_OPEN` link that `rer dev` prints. To update from 0.1.0, stop the old servers before pulling with `node scripts/rer.mjs dev --stop` and `node scripts/rer.mjs preview --stop`, install the global rer command with `curl -fsSL https://runeditrun.com/install.sh | sh` (or `npm install -g @runeditrun/rer`), then run `git pull --ff-only` and `rer dev`. Back up first with `rer export --output exports/NAME.rer` (0.1.0: `node scripts/rer.mjs export --output exports/NAME.rer` while its servers are stopped). Restore only into an empty destination with `rer import --input exports/NAME.rer --yes` after restoring the original private settings. For hosted coordination, follow Install and run → Host for your team: configure remote sign-in mail and run `rer deploy` with your Cloudflare credentials; rer claims the owner and retires the setup token. Open the app address and sign in by emailed link, or with `rer signin`. Update an existing hosted installation with `rer deploy`, preserving its owner and data. Remove with `rer deploy --remove --yes` and confirm its empty readback. Paging stays OFF; keep your existing pager active. Independent standby and paging delivery are outside this release.
